name: @globaltalk-ai/api-specs
description: Public authoritative OpenAPI 3.1.0 and AsyncAPI 3.0.0 specifications for GlobalTalk AI and Desi Language AI

scripts.lint: npm run lint:openapi && npm run lint:asyncapi
scripts.generate:ts-client: npx openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi.yaml -g typescript-axios -o generated/typescript-axios
scripts.generate:python-client: npx openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi.yaml -g python -o generated/python

author: GlobalTalk AI Authors and Contributors
